name: the ferry landing
notes: Training level A1 (D-59): a ferry landing on the south bank of the Wend. Fields as in data/maps/village.json.

art.ground: a muddy riverbank landing: trodden earth and gravel, reeds and tufts of grass, a cart track coming up from the bottom, scattered stones

pieces.River: a wide, slow, brown river with gentle ripples and reeds along its near edge
pieces.Jetty: a short wooden jetty of weathered planks on posts, running out into water
pieces.Ferry: a long flat wooden ferry raft with low rails, moored lengthwise in water, seen from above
pieces.Hut: a small timber ferryman's cottage with a reed-thatched roof and a door facing down
pieces.Rack: a long wooden rack with fishing nets hung over it to dry
pieces.Boat: an old rowing boat lying upside down on the bank
pieces.Woodpile: a neat stack of split firewood

entry.admit: agrees to take the stranger across the river on the ferry
entry.let_through: agrees to take the stranger across the river on the ferry
entry.let_in: Gorm has agreed to take them across; they haven't gone aboard yet
deed: Gorm agreed to take you over on his ferry.
entry.fallback_admit: Get aboard, then. Mind the gap.
entry.fallback_vouch: Leave it with me. I'll have a word with Gorm.

after_arrest.words: throw you off the landing onto the cart track
